title: Raven vs. Dreamer: the feud that defines ECW
summary: Raven’s fictional shared past with Tommy Dreamer turns their rivalry into a story of resentment, manipulation and repeated frustration. Dreamer can hurt Raven but struggles to secure the decisive win.

chapters.title: Raven wins the first major encounter
chapters.result: Raven defeats Dreamer with Beulah’s involvement.
chapters.context: The alliance around Raven repeatedly denies Dreamer a satisfying resolution.

chapters.title: Dreamer helps cost Raven the title
chapters.result: Funk defeats Raven after Dreamer intervenes.
chapters.context: Dreamer helps his mentor become champion, yet still lacks his own signature victory over Raven.

chapters.title: Dreamer finally pins Raven
chapters.result: Dreamer wins the Loser Leaves ECW match.
chapters.context: The long-awaited televised payoff ends Raven’s first ECW run before his move to WCW.
